# Imminiq

Imminiq is an adaptive learning platform for personalized roadmaps, AI-guided lessons,
collaborative learning guilds, live practice, mock tests, revision, and mastery analytics.

## Public pages

- [Product overview](/): Core product capabilities and links to create an account or sign in.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): How Imminiq handles personal information.
- [Terms of service](/terms): Rules and conditions for using Imminiq.

## Access

The dashboard, community library, learner profiles, and administration console require an
authenticated account. Automated clients should respect the access controls and the site's
robots.txt directives.
